text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just capturing a photo, a computer with vision can recognize what is in it. For example, image recognition can identify a cat, a tree, or a person’s face. A related skill is object detection, which not only identifies objects but also finds their exact location in a picture, often drawing a box around them. These abilities have many applications. In social media, they help tag friends automatically. More importantly, they are crucial for self-driving cars, which use cameras to detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other vehicles in real time, helping them to navigate safely.
